title: IM Management Platform imBee Raises $5M Series A Led by DCM
summary: On Oct 17, 2022, instant-messaging management platform imBee closed a $5M Series A led by DCM for tech depth, HK penetration, and APAC expansion. Product: “One-chat Experience” syncing WhatsApp Business API, WeChat, Facebook Messenger, Instagram into internal systems / Microsoft
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Company / Funding · October 20, 2022

On Oct 17, 2022, instant-messaging management platform imBee closed a $5M Series A led by DCM for tech depth, HK penetration, and APAC expansion. Product: “One-chat Experience” syncing WhatsApp Business API, WeChat, Facebook Messenger, Instagram into internal systems / Microsoft Teams; workflow engine hooks 360+ apps (Salesforce, HubSpot…). ISO 27001 team inbox; AWS-hosted. Clients: top HK banks, brokers, insurers, developers + luxury/retail/health. Drag-and-drop self-serve to cut data-ops load; personalized engagement over ticket-volume CS.

— END —
